info.title: Trunk Dynamic CI API (beta)
info.description: Dynamic CI endpoints in beta. An endpoint and this spec can change at any time, without notice. Fetch this spec again at least every 5 minutes to stay current, and do not commit a script or integration that depends on a beta endpoint. Endpoints move to `/v2` when they are stable. Authentication, errors and rate limits are those of the Trunk API v2.

apiKey.description: An API key, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. An organization admin creates one in the Trunk app under **Settings → Developer → API Keys** and chooses the permissions it holds. A key with none can read merge queues but change nothing in them. Permissions cover merge queues and test-result uploads, including the quarantine lookups a CI run makes before it uploads; any key can call the other Flaky Tests and Dynamic CI endpoints, including their writes.

trunkToken.name: x-trunk-token
trunkToken.description:
A short-lived token that Trunk's own tools send in the `x-trunk-token` header: the `trunk` CLI after `trunk auth login`, and the `trunk-io/login` action in a GitHub Actions run. Your own integrations should use an API key instead. Never send `Authorization` and `x-trunk-token` on the same request.

**A token from a GitHub Actions run can only upload and read impacted targets** (`PUT /v2/impacted-targets` and `GET /v2/pull-requests/{id}/impacted-targets`), for the repository the run belongs to. On a pull request from a fork it can also call the Flaky Tests CLI endpoints. Every other endpoint refuses it.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page. Pass it back verbatim as `cursor`; do not construct or inspect one.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter. Present only when the request set `includeTotal=true`.

path.description: The workflow file's path. Null if Trunk has not seen one.

jobId.description: Trunk's durable id for the job definition.

jobKey.description: The workflow's declarative `jobs:` key. **Null until Trunk has resolved it** — such a job gets no verdict from `dynamicCi.generatePlan` and therefore always runs. It is listed anyway, because it is still part of the repository's job set.

name.description: The rendered display name, which carries matrix values and can change. Address a job by `jobId` or `jobKey`, never by this.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong. Not stable — do not parse.

ErrorResponse.description: The error envelope. Every error this API itself returns has this shape, except a `413` for a body over 512 KB and a `504` for a request that runs past its time limit, which are plain text. Responses from Trunk's edge, such as a `401`, a `403` for a missing credential, a `429` or a `503`, can arrive before the request reaches the API and may not have it, so read `error.code` only when the body is JSON with an `error` object.

ErrorCode.description: Stable machine-readable error identifier. Switch on this, never on `message`. A shipped code's meaning never changes, but **new codes may be added within v2** — treat an unrecognized code as a generic failure of its HTTP status rather than failing closed.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available.

headShaAtSave.description: The pull request's head commit when the force was saved.

ForceOverrideScope.description: What a force covers: every job on the pull request, every job in one workflow, or a single job.

headSha.description: The pull request's head commit, recorded with each force as evidence of what it was saved against.

overrides.description: The complete desired set. An empty array clears every force on the pull request.

host.description: Disambiguates GitHub.com from a GitHub Enterprise Server host. `github.com` is the only supported value today.

workflowId.description: Required for `workflow` and `job`; rejected on a `pullRequest` scope, which would otherwise force the whole pull request without saying so.

jobId.description: Required for `job`; rejected on any other scope, which would otherwise force more than the job named.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page. Pass it back verbatim as `cursor`; do not construct or inspect one.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter. Present only when the request set `includeTotal=true`.

name.description: Null for an unnamed filter, which the web app shows as Custom.

jobs.description: The jobs the filter gates. A job the web app gave one filter for pull requests and another for the merge queue is listed under both.

include.description: A changed file counts when some `include` rule matches it and no `exclude` rule does.

glob.description: A picomatch glob, matched with `dot: true` against the repository-relative path. May not begin with `!` or `(`.

changeTypes.description: Match only these kinds of change. Absent matches any.

ChangeType.description: A kind of file change, as `dorny/paths-filter` names them.

workflowPath.description: The workflow file's path. Null if Trunk has not seen one.

jobKey.description: The job's key under `jobs:`. Null means the job is reachable only by `jobId`.

filters.description: One per `filters` entry, leaving out an entry none of whose jobs resolved.

jobs.description: One per job named, in request order. A job named by `jobId` is reported by its path and key.

name.description: The stored name, which an existing named filter keeps.

jobCount.description: Distinct jobs on the filter after the write.

WrittenFilterStatus.description: Whether the request created the filter or found it by its rules.

jobIds.description: Every job the name matched; one name can match more than one. Empty for `unresolved`.

WrittenJobStatus.description: `set`: the job now has the filter. `unchanged`: nothing was written. `cleared`: its filter was removed. `unresolved`: Trunk has not seen the job run, so nothing was written; send the request again after it runs.

overwrite.description: Replace a different filter already on a job. Without it, such a job fails the request with `PATHS_FILTER_CONFLICT`.

clear.description: Jobs to remove the paths filter from.

name.description: Trimmed; blank or absent is unnamed. Names a new filter, or an existing unnamed one with the same rules; an existing name is kept.

JobRef.description: A job, as `{ workflowPath, jobKey }` or as `{ jobId }`.

workflowPath.description: The workflow file's repository-relative path, exactly.

jobKey.description: The job's key under `jobs:` in that file.

jobId.description: A job's id from `dynamicCi.listPathsFilters` or `dynamicCi.listPrJobs`. A `workflowPath` or `jobKey` sent beside it must name the same job.

workflowPath.description: The workflow file's repository-relative path, exactly.

jobKey.description: The job's key under `jobs:` in that file.

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null on the last page. Pass it back verbatim as `cursor`; do not construct or inspect one.

hasMore.description: True when another page is available.

total.description: Total rows matching the filter. Present only when the request set `includeTotal=true`.

totalPages.description: Pages of `limit` decisions that match the filter. Present only with `includeTotal=true`.

id.description: Stable for the decision. A decision's `outcome`, `falseSkip` and `skipNotHonored` can change after it is first listed, so a copy keyed on this id should be refreshed.

jobId.description: The job, as `dynamicCi.listPrJobs` and force overrides name it.

name.description: The name the job ran under. A matrix variation's carries its values.

variationId.description: The matrix variation this decision is for, when the job is decided per variation.

pullRequest.description: The pull request the run tested. A merge-queue run's is the one its branch names. Null for a push.

allowListed.description: The actor or a label is on the repository's Learning allow list, so the decision was served as if Enforced.

recommendation.description: Dynamic CI's verdict for the job.

skipNotHonored.description: An Enforced or Evolving skip whose job ran anyway, so nothing was saved. Flagged for 24 hours after the decision only.

falseSkip.description: Trunk found the skip wrong: the job failed in its own run, or a merge-queue run that included the skip failed. It can become true hours after the decision.

signals.description: Each signal's vote on this decision, ignored signals left out. Present only with `include=signals`.

DecisionLane.description: Where the job ran: a pull request's CI, a merge-queue test run, or a run Trunk started before the pull request entered the queue.

DecisionMode.description: The repository's Dynamic CI mode when the decision was made. In `learning` a skip is only recorded and the job runs. `unknown` is a decision from before Trunk stored the mode.

DecisionReason.description: How the engine reached the recommendation: a signal forced a run or a skip, too many signals had no data so the job ran, the weighted vote decided, or the workflow cannot remove this matrix variation.

DecisionOutcome.description: What the job did, whatever was recommended. `failed` includes a timeout. `inProgress` is a job that is running or has not reported yet.

pullRequest.description: The pull request's page in Trunk, at this commit, on its Dynamic CI tab. Null with no pull request, or when Trunk has no repository record for it.

job.description: The commit's CI trace in Trunk, with the job's span selected when the job ran.

falseSkipProof.description: The failed run that showed the skip was wrong. Null unless `falseSkip`.

weight.description: The signal's weight in the vote. Null for a decision made before Trunk stored weights.

DecisionSignalVote.description: `mustRun` and `neverRun` force the decision. `voteRun` and `voteSkip` are weighted by confidence. `incomplete` is a signal with too little data.

get.summary: List the jobs Dynamic CI sees
get.description:
The workflows that have run on a pull request in this repository recently, with the jobs each defines. Use it to find the `workflowId` and `jobId` to force with `dynamicCi.setForceOverrides`.

`jobKey` is `null` for a job whose key Trunk has not resolved — it can never be skipped, and is listed so that is visible rather than silently missing.

put.summary: Replace a pull request's force overrides
put.description:
Requires the **Force CI jobs to run** permission.

Sets the complete list of forces active on a pull request. **This replaces the set, it does not add to it** — a force you omit is revoked, and an empty list clears them all. Send the desired end state, not a delta.

Scopes are addressed by the `workflowId` and `jobId` that `dynamicCi.listPrJobs` returns. An already-active force is left alone, so re-sending an unchanged list changes nothing. Forces are applied the next time `dynamicCi.generatePlan` runs for this pull request; this does not re-run anything itself.

get.description: Every paths filter in the repository, each with the jobs it gates. A paths filter decides which changed files make a job run, on pull requests and in the merge queue alike. An item with jobs can be sent back as one `filters` entry of `dynamicCi.setPathsFilters`, with its `name`, `rules` and `jobs`. A job the web app gave one filter for pull requests and another for the merge queue is listed under both: sending both items back leaves it as is, and sending one alone is a conflict, since the job also has the other filter.

patch.summary: Set or clear paths filters on jobs
patch.description:
Requires the **Update Dynamic CI settings** permission.

Sets a paths filter on each job named in `filters`, and removes it from each job in `clear`. Name a job by its workflow file and its key under `jobs:`. Each filter applies to pull requests and the merge queue alike. A request names at most 500 jobs in all, across every `filters[].jobs` and `clear`.

It changes only the jobs it names. It never deletes a filter; one the request leaves with no jobs stays in the list, with no jobs. Sending the same body again changes nothing, so no `Idempotency-Key` is needed. A job that already has a different filter fails the request with `PATHS_FILTER_CONFLICT` unless `overwrite` is true. Any error means nothing was written.

get.description:
**Beta.** This endpoint and its spec can change at any time, without notice. Fetch the spec again at least every 5 minutes (`GET /v2beta/dynamic-ci/openapi.json`), and do not commit a script or integration that depends on this shape.

Every job decision Dynamic CI made, newest first, as the Decisions page lists them: whether it recommended a run or a skip, why, and what the job then did. Every repository in the organization unless `owner` and `name` name one, over the last 7 days unless `since` and `until` say otherwise.

A decision can change after it is listed: `outcome` fills in when the job finishes, and `falseSkip` can become true hours later. To keep a copy, read the window again with some overlap and replace each decision by `id`. The cursor holds the window the first page used, so a decision made while you page does not move a page, and a cursor whose window starts more than a day past the 90-day limit is refused.
